newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's assigns Aaa to Finland's Municipal Housing.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aaa to Finland's Municipal Housing.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Moody's said on Tuesday it assigned an Aaa rating to Finland's Municipal Housing Finance Ltd's (MHF) forthcoming one billion Finnish markka bond issue, due 2002.
The issue is guaranteed by the Municipal Guarantee Board (MGB), Moody's said in a statement.

The rating reflects that 90 percent of MHF's lending is to new municipal housing projects under Finland's interest subsidy scheme whereby the government provides subsidies and deficiency guarantees to lenders, Moody's said.
In addition, MHF has a first mortgage on the buildings or a guarantee from the involved municipalities, the agency said.
Also, Finland has extensive regulation covering the area of housing benefits for tenants and MHF benefits from strong support from the Municipal Guarantee Board, Moody's said.
MHF, established in 1993, provides long-term finance for state-subsidised housing to Finnish municipalities and to municipality-guaranteed entities.
